name: Sherd: Fragment from the Base of a Circular Dish with Flat Floor, Angled Walls, and Splayed Footring
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；first quarter 12th century；Ru ware: light gray stoneware body with pale bluish celadon glaze, the glaze with white to buff cloudiness due either to under firing or to burial (in the waste heap at the kiln site). From the Ru kilns, Henan province
